The role is responsible for ensuring operational delivery, team accountability, workforce mobilization and demobilization, site coordination, camp and welfare management, transportation, manpower supplier management, and continuous improvement . A key mandate is to professionalize and digitize operations through Odoo, automation, data, and appropriate AI applications to improve efficiency, visibility, cost control, and service delivery. Key Responsibilities 1. Operations Leadership & Team Accountability • Lead day-to-day operations across Manforce Trading.  • Establish clear responsibilities, KPIs, deadlines, and accountability for each team member.  • Conduct regular operational reviews and ensure agreed actions are completed on time.  • Identify operational risks, delays, manpower shortages, and service issues early and drive corrective action.  • Build a culture of ownership, urgency, discipline, and follow-through.  • Ensure operational issues are resolved at the appropriate level and escalated only when necessary.    2. Workforce Mobilization, Demobilization & Site Operations • Build an efficient and scalable capability to mobilize and demobilize manpower according to client schedules.  • Coordinate manpower readiness, documentation, accommodation, transport, PPE, inductions, access requirements, and site deployment.  • Maintain visibility of manpower that is available, mobilizing, deployed, demobilizing, or idle.  • Manage replacements, transfers, absenteeism, emergency manpower requirements, and redeployment.  • Coordinate closely with client and site representatives to ensure reliable manpower delivery.  • Resolve operational complaints and site issues quickly while maintaining strong client relationships.  • Minimize idle manpower through effective deployment and redeployment planning.    3. Camp, Welfare, Transportation, Safety & Management • Oversee workforce accommodation, camp occupancy, cleanliness, maintenance, discipline, security, and welfare.  • Ensure accommodation capacity is aligned with current and upcoming workforce requirements.  • Establish regular camp inspection and issue-resolution processes.  • Ensure workforce welfare concerns are addressed promptly and appropriately.  • Manage transport planning between camps, sites, offices, medical centres, and other required locations.  • Improve route planning, vehicle utilization, punctuality, and transport cost efficiency.  • Maintain contingency arrangements for transport failures and urgent manpower movements.  • Ensure safety awareness and strict compliance including availability of PPE and tools required.    4. Manpower Suppliers & Operational Vendors • Build and maintain a strong network of reliable local manpower suppliers .  • Maintain sufficient supplier depth to avoid dependency on individual vendors.  • Evaluate suppliers based on capacity, manpower quality, rates, documentation, responsiveness, and reliability.  • Maintain preferred and backup suppliers for key manpower categories.  • Monitor supplier performance and address recurring service failures.  • Manage other operational vendors including transport, accommodation, and workforce-support providers where required.  • Ensure vendor arrangements support rapid scaling without compromising quality or cost discipline.    5. The Operations Manager is expected to act as the business owner of operational systems , not as the technical developer.   6. Required Qualifications & Experience • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, HR, or a related discipline.  • Minimum 7 years of relevant operational experience .  • Strong experience in manpower supply, contracting, workforce services, facilities management, construction support, industrial services, or a similar labour-intensiveenvironment.  • Demonstrated experience managing operational teams and holding people accountable for delivery.  • Experience in workforce mobilization, deployment, logistics, and site operations.  • Understanding of workforce accommodation, welfare, and transportation.  • Experience managing manpower suppliers and operational vendors.  • Demonstrated process-improvement capability.  • Practical experience with ERP or operational management systems; Odoo experience is an advantage .  • Good understanding of technology, automation, data, and AI applications in operations.  • Qatar/GCC experience is preferred.    Key Skills & Competencies • Operational leadership and accountability  • Workforce planning and deployment  • Mobilization and demobilization management  • Client and site relationship management  • Camp and workforce welfare management  • Transport and logistics coordination  • Manpower supplier and vendor management  • Process improvement and SOP development  • Odoo / ERP awareness  • Automation and AI awareness  • Cost and resource optimization  • Data-driven management  • Problem-solving and execution discipline  • Cross-functional coordination  • Strong communication and negotiation skills    Success Measures & KPIs Performance will be measured against areas such as: • Mobilizations completed within client-required timelines.  • Manpower deployment and utilization.  • Reduction in idle manpower and avoidable operational costs.  • Replacement and issue-resolution turnaround time.  • Client operational satisfaction and reduction in recurring complaints.  • Camp and welfare performance.  • Transport punctuality and utilization.  • Availability and reliability of local manpower suppliers.  • Team KPI achievement and accountability.  • Odoo implementation and operational adoption.  • Reduction in manual processes and duplicated work.  • Measurable productivity gains from process improvement, automation, or AI.  • Overall reliability and scalability of operations.
